reviews.text: Lovely staff and a good and caring experience.

Don’t hesitate if you want the best pet care. This practice offers the most incredible service. Rui is an amazing vet who always goes above and beyond to support you and your pet through the maze of veterinary help and shows vast knowledge and experience. He is professional, charming and kind. The whole team are extremely compassionate and efficient. The premises is clean and everything works as it should.
Amazing care and patience for both of my anxious dogs. Best experience.

Brilliant vet. Fantastic new premises
Everyone is caring, friendly and obviously loves animals.
Informative about how to care for our dog, advice on payment plans & care schedules.
Had routine vaccinations, nail clipping & anal gland emptying - all included in payment plan

Dr Rui and Andrea were exceptional in the way they cared for my cat, Ben, during his illness. I left him at the clinic for the day so they could investigate what was wrong, and they treated him with such kindness. They also kept me informed and explained everything clearly throughout the day, which meant a lot when I was worried about him. I’m very grateful to them both.
Medivet Southfields have cared for my two accident prone, grass seed magnet schnauzers for the past eight years with great care and compassion. Highly recommended

Everything ran to time and the service was great -
Thank you
Absolutely wonderful practice, have used them for years. They are very kind, professional, friendly and always helpful. Every member goes above and beyond. Cannot recommend them enough. Lifesavers.

Cannot recommend these guys enough. My cat had quite a scary time with a "mass" recently and the team have been nothing but accommodating, supportive and looking for the best but cost effective options for us, proving they actually care for the animals rather treating this purely as a business
Always look after our pets and us so well!

five star clinic. real professionals and animals lovers.

Thank you!
Great experience and so kind to my furbaby

Me and my cat always receive the best care in this clinic. They are quick with responding to any requests or concerns, and it genuinely feels like they go the extra mile to make the experience feel personal and safe for both me and my pet.
Pleasant and honest service. Friendly. Love animals and good value for money. Usually see the same vet as well so he gets to know your dog by name
Professional and understanding vet
Mentioned this many times before but can not mention it enough. Bests vets in the game.
The whole team at Medivet Southfields are amazing - we are very lucky to know them. Thank you!

I’m here temporarily, visiting from West Sussex. Medivet saw my dog and gave me a repeat prescription for Librella, with no fuss, and at a great price! Thank you all very much, especially the receptionist who kept my old dog calm with attention and treats!
Poppy my cat just loved this place, she feels so calm and so do I , Vets are very kind and professional and so the receptionist, always very helpful.
Just a wonderful vets who absolutely adore all our pets. Couldn’t recommend them more!

As always I had stellar service. I called with a mild emergency and they fit me in on the same day. Rui wasn't there. I explained that Thunder was nervous and anxious. They treated him wonderfully.  Thank you for always being so caring with my crazy pup!
Rui and all the team are very professional from booking appointments to attending for consultations. Really impressive!
Always a good experience here for our two cats and us.
Best veterinary surgery ever. From receptionists to nurses to vets. Lovely atmosphere that they are mostly Portuguese....
Rui treated our dog with the utmost care and gentleness.  Andrea gave him a helping hand and he was also so kind and caring with Pedro.   I am very happy that Pedro is in Medivet Southfields  care.
Always friendly and welcoming, even my dog tells me she enjoys her visits.

Was able to have an appointment the morning following my call. Vet Rui saw my cat Rolo who had been panting the previous day. ALL fully checked, all now good. Received wormer, vaccination, dietary advice for slight overweight. 3 brand new surgeries in recent major refurbishment.
Great staff, always very caring , friendly and knowledgeable. Lovely veterinary practitioners.
Spiros could not have been more gentle and skillful in examining my cat. He was thorough and clear in explaining everything to me.

We have been with MediVet Southfields since March 2012 and to say they are exceptional is an understatement. The care and time they have taken to look after our two Polish Lowland Sheepdogs is wonderful. Sadly we had to say goodbye to our youngest two days before her 10th birthday in June 2024. Rui and Andrea are beyond special with their compassion and thoughtfulness and we cannot thank them enough for everything they have done, both for Zosia who adored them and for us at a really sad time. The care and kindness they have given to us and still do as we navigate things in a much quieter house with just our older and now blind dog who also loves Rui and Andrea and pulls us into the vets when we walk past (somehow she always knows exactly where we are so she can have a fuss from the team) is amazing.

The fact that there is a whole network of practices and vet hospitals within the group has been really helpful over the years with our dogs when we have needed a vet when not in our local area. The specialist expertise too within the company (orthopaedics, cancer etc) is second to none.

Our dogs have regularly travelled extensively throughout Europe all their lives and no vets (which we have to see for the passport to be stamped - luckily we have a EU pet passports so are not stuck with having to use the extremely expensive, administratively bureaucratic, short time-limited thing the UK now has after Brexit) have gone anywhere near the mark that Rui and his team at MediVet Southfields have.

Hamish our labrador was a very reluctant patient - it took two vets to push him into the consulting room! The staff were both efficient and friendly; the one problem was having to wait 45 minutes after the time of our appointment to be seen.
Helpful staff, very friendly. The vet was very gentle with our cat.

Best we've ever had, can't thank our friends enough for recommending it to us.
All the staff fin there know our dogs by name immediately and have a genuine love of pets and work around their needs.
I've never felt ripped off or had to question additional charges, they are upfront with quotes and very helpful and honest.
Maggie was a petrified anxious mess of a dog that had to be sedated and muzzled for a nail clip, she's now off the meds and muzzle.
Good clinic in Southfield
Always a fantastic service - professional and caring

Medivet are wonderful, their staff are so lovely and truly care for the animals they treat.  The vets are extremely patient and gentle and offers lots of guidance and advice on caring for our pets.  Thank you so much!
Absolutely amazing team and incredible care for our babies. Couldn't recomend more!

My experience at MediVet was excellent. Rui, a wonderful vet, consistently takes the time to clearly explain every aspect of my cat’s health, which I truly appreciate. The newly refurbished layout at Southfield MediVet is also very nice.

We were quoted over £ 1,200 for dental work for my cat (including multiple tooth extractions). We went to another vet who charged £ 250 and said he didn’t need any extractions - over a year later and his teeth are still fine so clearly he didn’t need extractions. I’m so glad we didn’t pay so much money for my cat to have to go through a painful and traumatic unnecessary procedure. I don’t know how the vets can justify the insane costs here plus upselling of unnecessary expensive items (with a huge mark up). Save your money and take your pets elsewhere!

Rui & his team  do an amazing job, really caring & professional.
Thoroughly recommend!
Great experience. The vet and staff are very kind and know exactly how to help my dog. Highly Recommend.

I have no qualms over the services they provide are will always put the considerations of the pet first, but I have serious considerations over their practices to overtreat and overprescribe. I would always price compare because Medivet's margins seem very high compared to independent vets
Rui and his team are always very friendly knowledgeable and great with my cats. Highly recommend.

I honestly don’t have enough words to express how thankful I am for the incredible team at Medivet-Southfields. We went through one of the most difficult experiences with our dog, and thanks to the skill, dedication, and compassion of Dr. Rui Laurenco and his amazing staff, she is not only still with us — she’s walking on all four legs again.

Their care during that critical time was nothing short of life-saving. They never gave up on her, and it’s clear they treat every animal with the same love and attention they’d give their own. I truly believe that without them, she wouldn’t be here today.

Even now, during her routine check-ups and vaccinations, they continue to be just as attentive, kind, and thorough. It’s such a comfort to know she’s in good hands, whether it’s an emergency or just a wellness visit.

Thank you from the bottom of my heart for everything you've done — and continue to do — for our girl. We’re so lucky to have you as our vet!
Highly recommended, they really care about my dog

Our Senior dog Alfie has being a patient at Medivet-Southfields for the past 10 years and we couldn’t be happier. Rui and the rest of the team are fantastic, with them you know your furry friends are in the best hands, they always go the extra mile, we’re so grateful to Southfields and every staff-member, your work is highly appreciated. Thank you!
We have been with Medivet Southfields for over a year and both cats of ours get the best care. Thank you for the team for taking care of us.
Dr Sam, was absolutely brilliant with “our” broken dew claw and a slightly anxious dog. Thank you to all team for looking after him as always.
This team and wonderfully caring - our cat is in the best of hands
I can’t thank the the team enough for their support and care of my dog when he was ill recently.   The nurses and vet were all so caring and helpful. A fantastic team
Southfields Medivet are a friendly, knowledgeable team taking gentle care with the pets under their care and appear to enjoy their work too.

I love our vets, the team have always been so friendly and gentle with pets, even our very grumpy and anxious old cat. I will forever be grateful for the speed with which they were able to help him find comfort in his final minutes. Now, they are just as kind and warm with our puppy. I happy put my trust in them all.
Always helpful and efficient.

I was very happy with the excellent advice and compassionate care by the vet and vet's assistant during our rescue dog's free initial check up. It was a bonus that they trimmed her nails too and she was very calm throughout.
Lovely, calm staff who support me and my barky (reactive) dog really well. Thank you!

Had such an amazing experience with the team at Southfields Medivet! Dr. Rui and his assistant made my basset hound feel super comfortable with kind words, gestures, and treats, and explained everything to me thoroughly regarding potential reasons for the issue, ways of treating/managing, and what to prepare for in the future. Really, really pleased and would recommend them to anyone in the area!

Wonderful team in Southfields! Very thorough, kind, helpful and efficient!
Thank you to wonderful team and particularly to Dr Rui! Amazingly kind, gentle with animals and so knowledgeable! Thank you one and all! Marcia
Great first experience of using this practice.  The vet Sam was really lovely.
Very happy with Medivet, they are always friendly and professional.
The best service ever. Very professional, friendly and helpful. Looks after your pet with love and care.

The staff are always helpful and kind when it is needed. We trust the team and always receive excellent care for our cat.
